title: Adaptive legend overlays and interruptible toolbar for compact dashboard surfaces
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: improve density and interaction resilience for the Console dashboard and cost explorer by introducing an interruptible top toolbar and adaptive legend overlays that gracefully condense on narrow viewports and across legacy browsers. This ticket covers visual specs, responsive layout rules, interaction prototypes, cross-browser issue triage, and a review pass with front-end engineers. Rationale: teams with many cost/rollout panels need fast access to filters and actions without losing chart context when the viewport is constrained or when modals are open. The interruptible toolbar provides a progressive collapse (icons -> compact chip group -> overflow) with keyboard-first focus behavior. Legends become overlays that can pin/unpin, auto-collapse to an indicator when space is tight, and support hover/tap interactions consistently across Chromium, WebKit, and ESR Firefox builds.
acceptance_criteria: Toolbar collapses into compact icon set at 960px and further into overflow menu at 720px without layout jank
Legend overlays position themselves to avoid occluding the primary chart canvas and animate with reduced motion preferences honored
All interactions work in latest Chrome, Safari, and Firefox ESR; identified CSS fallbacks for older WebKit where position: sticky is unreliable
Keyboard navigation: toolbar items and legend toggles are reachable via Tab and announce state via ARIA; focus trap avoided when opening modal overlays
Prototype validated with two sample Console pages: Cost Explorer (multi-line/spark charts) and Rollouts (timeline + table) with no clipping on typical enterprise SSO widths
Design handoff includes tokens (spacing, breakpoints, z-index map), interaction flows, and a QC checklist for engineering implementation
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Initial sketching session with product and eng; agreed primary breakpoints at 1280/960/720
2026-03-04: High-fidelity prototype (Figma) for toolbar collapse states and legend overlay behavior uploaded; linked in prototypes_links
2026-03-06: Cross-browser exploration uncovered a stacking context issue in Safari when using transform-based animations; workaround proposed to use opacity + translateY with will-change hints
2026-03-08: Accessibility review flagged missing ARIA-expanded on overflow menu and recommended an offscreen live region for legend state changes

2026-03-10: Internal review with frontend team; agreed to implement a CSS-first solution with minimal JS for measurement; engineering raised a perf question around repaint cost for many concurrent charts
decisions: Use three breakpoint tiers (>=1280, 960-1279, 720-959, <720) with discrete toolbar states
Legends will default to pinned overlay on desktop and auto-collapse to a single badge on narrow viewports
Prefer CSS transitions (opacity/translate) and avoid transform scale for Safari compatibility
Implement a small measurement shim in JS to toggle collapsed state only when necessary to avoid continuous layout thrashing
Provide a feature flag to gradually roll out across environments and enable rollback if perf regressions appear
review_feedback: PM (Riley): emphasize discoverability for overflowed filter chips — add a micro-CTA and hover hint
Frontend (Amir): request for explicit z-index map and a minimal helper utility for overlay stacking to avoid ad-hoc z values
QA (Fatima): include scenarios for screen magnification and high-DPI where pixel rounding caused tiny overlap in toolbar icons
Design (Hannah): refine iconography contrasts for the compact toolbar to pass 3:1 contrast at small sizes
cross_browser_issues: Safari (<15) transform stacking causes overlay to get clipped when parent has -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch — workaround: avoid 3D transforms on containing elements
Firefox ESR: position: sticky on nested flex children behaves inconsistently when min-height set; recommended to avoid sticky for legend pinning in that browser and fallback to fixed overlay
Edge (Legacy): tested low marketshare but causes different subpixel rounding; engineering to ensure snap-to-pixel utilities are used for icon placement
accessibility_considerations: Keyboard: ensure toolbar overflow menu uses roving tabindex and aria-expanded on the trigger
Screen reader: announce legend state changes via aria-live polite region
Motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling translate transitions and favor instant state changes
Contrast: compact toolbar icons and chip labels must meet 3:1 at minimum sizes per WCAG 2.1 AA for non-text components
qa_notes: Test scenarios: desktop Firefox/Chrome/Safari, iPad Safari landscape/portrait, narrow window widths down to 360px
Focus ring tests when opening overlay on top of charts and inside modals (no focus loss or trapped focus)
Performance: render 12 small charts on a single page and verify frame drops not introduced by overlay toggles
Regression: verify existing rollout modal stacking and cost table sorting remain unaffected

Frontend to prototype a CSS-first implementation and share a demo branch for perf profiling (assigned Amir)
QA to run cross-browser checklist on the demo branch and report blockers by 2026-03-15
